question: South Asian leaders signed the SAARC Charter at the first summit in _________ in the year 1985.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dhaka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• South Asian leaders signed the SAARC Charter at the first summit in **Dhaka** in the year **1985**.
 
• The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) was established with the signing of the SAARC Charter in Dhaka on** 8 December 1985.**
 
• The Headquarters and Secretariat of the Association are in **Kathmandu, Nepal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• SAARC comprises **3% of the world's area**, 21% of the world's population and 3.8% (US$2.9 trillion) of the global economy.
 
• **SAARC Development Fund's** primary objective is the funding of project-based collaboration in social sectors such as poverty alleviation, development, etc.
 
• It is the world’s most densely populated region and one of the most fertile areas.
 
• SAARC comprises of **eight-member States**:
 
 
• Afghanistan
 
• Bangladesh
 
• Bhutan
 
• India
 
• Maldives
 
• Nepal
 
• Pakistan
 
• Sri Lanka
